description: REQ-BILL-022 states: 'Note: The __Host-link_session is consumed on this path (consumed at pre-validation pass point).' for the cancel idempotent case (cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL). However, cancel.ts lines 88-93 return the idempotent response BEFORE the consumeLinkSession call at line 96. The link session is NOT consumed on the idempotent path, violating the spec. PROP-BILL-047 test does not verify consumeLinkSession was called.
